query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
           FROM search_index s
           LEFT JOIN search_embeddings e
             ON e.org_id = s.org_id
            AND e.entity_kind = s.entity_kind
            AND e.entity_id = s.entity_id
            AND e.space = $2
           WHERE s.org_id = $1
             AND (
                   e.id IS NULL
                OR e.content_hash <> md5(s.title || E'\x1f' || s.body)
              )
